sentences.text: Researchers employed an iterative computational method to build shared structural and cellular definitions for the basal ganglia in humans, macaques, and marmosets, producing a new resource called the Harmonized Ontology of Mammalian Brain Anatomy (HOMBA).

The created atlases allow scientists to analyze how cells and molecules vary based on their specific location in the brain and enable comparisons of cellular, molecular, and functional differences between different primate species.
The project aims to connect large-scale brain imaging data with detailed cellular and tissue-level data.
